open_account.title: Open account
open_account.description: Return the account for this (category, holder_id), opening it if it does not exist yet. Opening is lazy and idempotent: an account exists because something was posted to it, never because its holder merely registered, and asking twice returns the same account rather than a second one.

get_account.title: Read account
get_account.description: Read one account by its storage id.

args.description: The account to read.

list_accounts.title: List accounts
list_accounts.description: List the chart of accounts, oldest-opened first.

args.description: Cap the accounts returned. Zero or absent means the default page.

close_account.title: Close account
close_account.description: Stamp an account closed. Refused while it still carries a balance, and refused if it is already closed.

args.description: The account to close.

account_balance.title: Read balance
account_balance.description: Fold one account's balance: everything debited to it minus everything credited from it, over every entry naming it. There is no stored balance anywhere in this module, so this is computed on every call.

args.description: The account to fold.

post_entry.title: Post entry
post_entry.description: Append one journal entry, debiting one account and crediting another for the same amount. There is no update and no delete: a mistake is corrected by posting a new entry that names the original in reverses_entry_id, and an entry may be reversed at most once. A reversal keeps its original's dimensions. A payment may name the charge it pays in settles_entry_id, which must be an entry already in the ledger.

list_entries.title: List entries
list_entries.description: Read one account's ledger, both sides, ordered on when the event occurred and falling back to when it was posted, oldest first so a running balance can be accumulated down the page.

args.description: The account whose ledger to read.
Cap the entries returned. Zero or absent means the default page.

set_budget.title: Set budget
set_budget.description: Set what one account is expected to hold over one period. Setting it again for the same account and period replaces the amount. The period runs from period_start, inclusive, to period_end, exclusive.

variance.title: Read variance
variance.description: Read one account's budget for a period beside its actual balance over that period, and the difference, actual minus budgeted. The actual folds only entries whose occurred_at, or posted_at where that is absent, falls inside the period.

args.description: The account to compare.
The period's first instant, inclusive, exactly as the budget was set.
The period's end, exclusive, exactly as the budget was set.

add_milestone.title: Add milestone
add_milestone.description: Record one stage of a contract against the account its spending is booked to, with what it is worth and when it is planned to be reached. It starts planned and is paid only through payment certificates.

list_milestones.title: List milestones
list_milestones.description: List the milestones planned against one account, oldest first, each with the amount certified so far.

args.description: The account whose milestones to list.
Cap the milestones returned. Zero or absent means the default page.

certify_payment.title: Certify payment
certify_payment.description: Issue a payment certificate for all or part of a milestone. The amount less the retention is posted from the milestone's account to the payee, and the retention, a share of the amount in hundredths of a percent, is posted to the retention account until it is released. Refused when the certificates would add up to more than the milestone is worth.

args.description: The milestone certified. The address decides, not the body.
Who certified the work, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

list_certificates.title: List certificates
list_certificates.description: List the payment certificates issued for one milestone, oldest first, each with its retention and whether it has been released.

args.description: The milestone whose certificates to list.
Cap the certificates returned. Zero or absent means the default page.

release_retention.title: Release retention
release_retention.description: Pay out the retention a certificate withheld, from the retention account to the payee. Refused before the certificate's release date, when nothing was withheld, and when it was already released.

args.description: The certificate whose retention to release.
Who released the retention, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

overdue_entries.title: List overdue entries
overdue_entries.description: Read one account's entries whose due_at has passed as of an instant, each with the whole days it is overdue, oldest first by age_days, which is the same as days_overdue unless age_from is "raised". An entry with no due_at is never listed, nor is an entry that has been reversed or one that reverses another. Unreversed entries naming a charge in settles_entry_id are netted against it: each item carries what is still outstanding, and a charge paid in full is not listed.

args.description: The account whose overdue entries to read.
The instant to age against, as an RFC 3339 instant. Absent means now.

Where each item's age_days starts counting and what the list is ordered on: "due" (the default) from the entry's due_at, "raised" from the day the entry was posted. Which entries are listed does not change. Any other value is refused.

list_entries_by_dimension.title: List entries by dimension
list_entries_by_dimension.description: Read one account's ledger narrowed to the entries whose dimensions carry the named key with exactly the given value, in the same order as the full listing.

args.description: The account whose ledger to read.
The dimension key to narrow by.
The value that key must carry.
Cap the entries returned. Zero or absent means the default page.

dimension_balance.title: Read balance by dimension
dimension_balance.description: Fold one account's debits minus credits over only the entries whose dimensions carry the named key with exactly the given value. The balances of an account under every value of one key sum to its whole balance only when every entry carries that key.

args.description: The account whose balance to read.
The dimension key to narrow by.
The value that key must carry.
